name: solver_merge_rung_rank_deficient_pair
source:
{ A consistent rank-deficient pair solves instantly at the default guesses to
  one point of its solution manifold (x = y = 1); the downstream block then
  needs a different point. The retry ladder's merge rung re-solves all three
  equations together and the SVD pseudo-inverse slides the pair along its
  manifold to x = 1.5. Recorded because it is what the Java comment
  "previously solved blocks may have incorrect values from SVD fallback on
  rank-deficient Jacobians" describes. Ledger item 40. }
x + y = 2
2*x + 2*y = 4
exp(w) = x - 1.5
